title: ‘Hindi tayo puwedeng mag-speculate’: Palace says no talks of Sara Duterte replacement
summary: There have been no talks of Vice President Sara Duterte’s potential replacement should senator-judges convict her at her ongoing impeachment trial, Malacañang said Thursday.
